experiment: H100 vLLM serving: graph ablations and dependency correction

frozen_graph_ablations.description: Original graph-policy ablations use the same frozen implementation.

dependency_correction.description: Separate implementation correction: opaque-op dependency enforces GPU shared-MLP execution before waiting for the reply.

data.hardware: 8 H100 80GB HBM3 GPUs, 4 Attention + 4 FFN across two four-GPU NVLink domains
data.network: Matched GPUDirect and NIC binding; one shared 200Gb/s RDMA port
data.plugin_runtime_state: Base plus FFN graph-replay ablation and lexical shared-expert placement; exact runtime source hashes below. Nsight shows compiler deferred shared GEMMs until after collect in this matrix. Explicit dependency correction evaluated separately.

graph_modes.P2P NCCL: Attention prefill eager; decode graphs1/8/32; FFN prefill eager/decodegraphs
graph_modes.afdEP graph: Attention prefill eager, decode graphs1/8/32; FFN one2048capacitygraph for prefill and decode
graph_modes.afdEP FFN eager: Same Attention graphs; FFN steady-state replay disabled; startup capture retained for Attention protocol pairing; same pooledbuffers/nativekernels/GEMMs
graph_modes.afdEP prefill eager: Same Attention graphs; FFN onlyprefill replay disabled, decode stillcapacitygraph

data.timing: Capture/JIT/startup excluded, everytimedgraphreplay included. NoNsightduringprimarytiming. Client-visibleITLfromstreamtokenIDs, no logprobs.
data.validation: Targeted GPU-container connector, graphpolicy, modelproxy and FFNvsPyTorch tests passed; broadermodelaccuracyunestablished (prior16naturalprompts15/16fullgreedyoutputs matchedP2P).

dependency_correction.validation: Both source snapshots agree; plugin files match committed source, native transport unchanged. GPU-container regression passed. Nsight ordering and six separately timed short/mixed repeats are evaluated separately from the frozen graph ablations.

nsight_ordering.meaning: Verified same-GPU shared MLP completion before collect; permits remote overlap, does not prove cross-host concurrency.

cfa2eebf345df5aff3048ab63ee61f4a1d1ecc7f.ttft: Request start to receipt of first token ID, including empty text.
cfa2eebf345df5aff3048ab63ee61f4a1d1ecc7f.itl: Client receipt gaps between adjacent one-token SSE events, pooled across requests; gaps touching multi-token events are excluded. Includes server, transport and client scheduling; not GPU step time.
cfa2eebf345df5aff3048ab63ee61f4a1d1ecc7f.tpot: Per request: (last-token receipt - first-token receipt)/(tokens-1). Includes coalesced tokens; excludes usage/HTTP completion tail.
cfa2eebf345df5aff3048ab63ee61f4a1d1ecc7f.timestamps: Raw timestamps use client perf_counter_ns; request_started_utc_ns is an approximate wall-clock anchor. SSE buffering can compress observed gaps; no generation times are inferred within a chunk.
cfa2eebf345df5aff3048ab63ee61f4a1d1ecc7f.percentiles: Linear interpolation; TPOT percentiles weight requests equally.
cfa2eebf345df5aff3048ab63ee61f4a1d1ecc7f.instrumentation: return_token_ids=true adds token IDs and first-chunk prompt IDs; use identically for all variants. No logprobs requested.

aggregation: Per-run metrics validated against raw requests. Bars are the median of run p50/p95 values; whiskers show the observed repeat range, not confidence intervals. ITL samples pool observed singleton-event gaps; TTFT and TPOT percentiles weight requests equally.
limitations: Client-observed ITL includes server, transport and client scheduling.
SSE/HTTP buffering can compress observed intervals; GPU step time is not inferred.
Coalesced tokens do not receive invented zero ITLs; coverage is reported.
Synthetic token prompts and closed-loop load do not establish production workload performance.

output_parity.definition: Exact generated token-ID sequences and first-token IDs for paired request indices/seeds.
output_parity.interpretation: Output differences can change downstream expert routing; matched input seeds and token counts do not imply identical routed work. These parity counts are not a model accuracy evaluation.
